metadata.split_strategy: same deterministic stratified 75/25 split as train_baselines.py
metadata.local_example_selection: For each experiment/model, take the first held-out row in deterministic split order for each predicted class; selection does not depend on correctness or contribution magnitude.
metadata.interpretation: Explanations describe model behavior on this controlled synthetic benchmark only. They do not establish causal relationships or real-world threat attribution.

LogisticRegression.attribution_method: encoded feature value × learned coefficient; local contributions add to the intercept in log-odds space
LogisticRegression.contribution_direction: positive values push toward the positive class; negative values push toward the negative class

global_model_feature_contribution.aggregation: mean and sum of absolute per-example log-odds contribution; signed mean is also reported

feature_group_contribution.aggregation: mean absolute and signed sum of feature log-odds contributions per held-out example; also normalized by encoded group width

GaussianNaiveBayes.attribution_method: per-feature Gaussian log-likelihood ratio log p(x_j|positive) - log p(x_j|negative); contributions add to log prior odds
GaussianNaiveBayes.contribution_direction: positive values push toward the positive class; negative values push toward the negative class
